requirements.answer_quote: 构建期指定一个或多个 optimization profile，给出运行时维度输入的允许范围，以及 auto-tuner 用于优化的维度。
requirements.evidence_quote: An *optimization profile* describes a range of dimensions for each network input and the dimensions the auto-tuner will use for optimization. You must create at least one optimization profile at build time when using runtime dimensions.
